sentences.text: As per the prosecution story, prosecutrix lodged an FIR at police station Karhi by stating that on 28.8.2022 at about 2 am applicant Shubham called her by sending massage on her mobile phone.
sentences._hearing_file: Shubham vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 20 April, 2023.json

sentences.text: When she went to the house of applicant, then the applicant committed rape upon her and also threatened her that if she discloses the incident to anyone, he would kill her.
sentences._hearing_file: Shubham vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 20 April, 2023.json

sentences.text: After ten days, the applicant again committed rape upon her three times.
sentences._hearing_file: Shubham vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 20 April, 2023.json

sentences.text: Accordingly a case has been registered against the applicant.
sentences._hearing_file: Shubham vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 20 April, 2023.json

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the applicant submits that applicant is innocent and he has been falsely implicated in this matter.
sentences._hearing_file: Shubham vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 20 April, 2023.json

sentences.text: Applicant is in jail since 29.8.2022.
sentences._hearing_file: Shubham vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 20 April, 2023.json

sentences.text:
Although earlier bail application of applicant was rejected on merit but thereafter prosecutrix (PW-1) and her parents (PW-2 & PW-3)
have been examined before the trial court and they have turned hostile and they did not state anything against the applicant about the aforesaid offence.
sentences._hearing_file: Shubham vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 20 April, 2023.json

sentences.text: Applicant is permanent resident of District Khargone.
sentences._hearing_file: Shubham vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 20 April, 2023.json

sentences.text: Final conclusion of trial will take considerable long time.
sentences._hearing_file: Shubham vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 20 April, 2023.json

sentences.text: Hence, he prays that in the changed circumstances, applicant be released on bail.
sentences._hearing_file: Shubham vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 20 April, 2023.json

sentences.text: Per-contra, learned PL for respondent/State opposes the bail application and prays for its rejection.
sentences._hearing_file: Shubham vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 20 April, 2023.json

sentences.text: Perused the case diary as well as the impugned order of the court below.
sentences._hearing_file: Shubham vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 20 April, 2023.json

sentences.text: Considering all the facts and circumstances of the case, arguments advanced by counsel for the parties, nature and gravity of allegation as also taking note of the fact that prosecutrix (PW-1) has been examined before the trail court and she has turned hostile and she categorically stated in her statement that present applicant neither abducted her nor committed any rape upon her, her parents PW-2 & PW-3 also deposed in the same manner and final conclusion of trial will take considerable long time, I deem it proper to release the applicant on bail.
sentences._hearing_file: Shubham vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 20 April, 2023.json

sentences.text: Accordingly, without commenting on the merits of the case, the application is allowed.
sentences._hearing_file: Shubham vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 20 April, 2023.json

sentences.text:
It is directed that the applicant be released on bail upon his furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.75,000/-
(Rs. Seventy Five Thousand only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court for his appearance before the trial Court, as and when required.

sentences.text:
This is first application filed under section 438 Cr.P.C. for grant of anticipatory bail to applicant Shubham, who is apprehending his arrest in connection with Crime No.18/2023 for the offences punishable under Sections 9, 10, 11 of Child Marriage Restraint Act and Sections 363, 366, 376 (3),
109, 506 of IPC and Sections 5/6, 16/17 of the Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act, 2012 registered at Police Station Mehgaon, District Bhind (Madhya Pradesh).

sentences._hearing_file: Shubham vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 21 April, 2023.json

sentences.text: The present applicant is apprehending his arrest in the aforesaid case where the applicant is said to have assisted the main accused Akash in abduction and rape of the prosecutrix who is a minor.
sentences._hearing_file: Shubham vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 21 April, 2023.json

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the respondent No.1/State while opposing the application for grant of anticipatory bail has read out from the 164 statement.
sentences._hearing_file: Shubham vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 21 April, 2023.json

sentences.text:
Before referring to the same, it is necessary to mention here that the F.I.R. was registered on 01.02.2023 and the 164 statement of the prosecutrix Shubham vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 21 April, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/132834356/
1 recorded a month later on 01.03.2023.

entities.text: prosecutrix Shubham vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences._hearing_file: Shubham vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 21 April, 2023.json

sentences.text: In her 164 statement, she says that she was forcibly married to one Sachin by her parents and at the time of marriage, she was 14 years and that this fact was known to her husband and her in-laws.
sentences._hearing_file: Shubham vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 21 April, 2023.json

sentences.text: She further states that her husband Sachin never made any kind of physical contact against her will.
sentences._hearing_file: Shubham vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 21 April, 2023.json

sentences.text: Thereafter, she states that she had gone to attend the marriage in her relationship and she wanted to return home to her in-laws place when the co- accused Arti alias Shivani, is stated to have told the prosecutrix that she is also headed in the same direction and that the prosecutrix could accompany her in the car.
sentences._hearing_file: Shubham vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 21 April, 2023.json

sentences.text: The vehicle was being driven by the co-accused Akash and the applicant Shubham was sitting in the vehicle.
sentences._hearing_file: Shubham vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 21 April, 2023.json

sentences.text: Midway, the co-accused Shivani is stated to have informed the prosecutrix that there was a call from her home and that she was returning and that she would not accompany them in the vehicle any longer and that the prosecutrix could go ahead to her destination alongwith Akash and the present applicant Shubham.
sentences._hearing_file: Shubham vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 21 April, 2023.json

sentences.text: The prosecutrix says that she resisted the proposal however, the applicant herein is stated to have in collaboration with the main accused and forcibly made her board the train alongwith Akash who is stated to have taken her to Farooq Nagar in Haryana and kept her their in a room and forcibly committed rape with her.
sentences._hearing_file: Shubham vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 21 April, 2023.json

sentences.text: She further says that during the stay together the main accused Akash had also taken photographs of himself alongwith prosecutrix and threatened to make them viral.
sentences._hearing_file: Shubham vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 21 April, 2023.json

sentences.text: Thereafter she says that a month later, she was recovered by the police who had reached there alongwith her parents.
sentences._hearing_file: Shubham vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 21 April, 2023.json

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the applicant submits that there is a further twist in this case.
sentences._hearing_file: Shubham vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 21 April, 2023.json

sentences.text: A Habeas Corpus petition was filed before this Court which is W.P.No.20184 of 2022 by the mother of the prosecutrix for the recovery of the prosecutrix allegedly from the forcible confinement of the main accused Akash.
sentences._hearing_file: Shubham vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 21 April, 2023.json

sentences.text: On 22.09.2022 during the course of proceedings, the prosecutrix herself appeared before the Division Bench of this Court alongwith the main accused Akash who was respondent No.6 in the Habeas Corpus petition and informed the Court that she had gone with the main accused Akash on her own volition as she did not want to go with the respondent No.4 in the writ petition with whom her parents had forcibly got her married to.
sentences._hearing_file: Shubham vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 21 April, 2023.json

sentences.text: The learned Division Bench by order dated 22.09.2022 further recorded that in inquiry it was found that in the Birth Certificate and the High School Certificate, the date of birth of the prosecutrix was revealed as 21.5.2007 according to which she was found to be 15 years of age and thus a minor.
sentences._hearing_file: Shubham vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 21 April, 2023.json

sentences.text:
The learned Division Bench thereafter recorded its angst as follows :-
"
sentences._hearing_file: Shubham vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 21 April, 2023.json

sentences.text: It is indeed shocking that the parents of........... married her to respondent No.4 while she was minor.
sentences._hearing_file: Shubham vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 21 April, 2023.json

sentences.text: It is an illegal act for which they are also liable for action.
sentences._hearing_file: Shubham vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 21 April, 2023.json

sentences.text: Nevertheless, as Ms.... is not inclined to go with her parents, we deem it proper to keep her in Nari Niketan One Stop Center at Bhind as in the obtaining facts and circumstances she cannot be permitted to live with respondent No.6 Akash, who is present in Court, for the reasons firstly she is minor and secondly there is no relationship with Akash in law."
sentences._hearing_file: Shubham vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 21 April, 2023.json

sentences.text: After this order was passed by the learned Division Bench, on 01.02.2023 the present F.I.R was registered against the applicant and the main accused Akash inter alia for the commission of rape of the prosecutrix.
sentences._hearing_file: Shubham vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 21 April, 2023.json

sentences.text: The statement of the prosecutrix was recorded under 164 on 01.03.2023 in which she has given a totally different versions and has made allegation against the applicant herein.
sentences._hearing_file: Shubham vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 21 April, 2023.json

sentences.text:

entities.text: Shubham vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences._hearing_file: Shubham vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 21 April, 2023.json

sentences.text: However, giving due regard to the fact that the prosecutrix herself had appeared before the learned Division Bench of this Court alongwith the main accused Akash and wherein she has stated that she had gone with the main accused on her own volition as she was forcibly married of to the person whom she had referred to as her husband, cannot be ignored as the said statement was made before the two judges of this Court which was recorded in the order dated 22.09.2022.
sentences._hearing_file: Shubham vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 21 April, 2023.json

sentences.text: Thus, on a prima facie appreciation of material on record, this Court comes to the conclusion that apparently the case is one of consent though the prosecutrix is a minor and the role of the applicant herein even if deemed to be true and correct, is peripheral and not associated with the main offence of the rape.
sentences._hearing_file: Shubham vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 21 April, 2023.json

sentences.text: Under the circumstances, the application is allowed.
sentences._hearing_file: Shubham vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 21 April, 2023.json

sentences.text: It is directed that if the applicant Shubham herein is arrested by the Arresting Officer, he shall be enlarged on bail upon his furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand Only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the Arresting Officer.
sentences._hearing_file: Shubham vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 21 April, 2023.json

sentences.text: C.C. as per rules.

opennyai_summary.21_April_2023__facts:
This is first application filed under section 438 Cr.P.C. for grant of anticipatory bail to applicant Shubham, who is apprehending his arrest in connection with Crime No.18/2023 for the offences punishable under Sections 9, 10, 11 of Child Marriage Restraint Act and Sections 363, 366, 376 (3),
109, 506 of IPC and Sections 5/6, 16/17 of the Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act, 2012 registered at Police Station Mehgaon, District Bhind (Madhya Pradesh).
The present applicant is apprehending his arrest in the aforesaid case where the applicant is said to have assisted the main accused Akash in abduction and rape of the prosecutrix who is a minor.
After this order was passed by the learned Division Bench, on 01.02.2023 the present F.I.R was registered against the applicant and the main accused Akash inter alia for the commission of rape of the prosecutrix.
opennyai_summary.21_April_2023__ANALYSIS:
The vehicle was being driven by the co-accused Akash and the applicant Shubham was sitting in the vehicle.
A Habeas Corpus petition was filed before this Court which is W.P.No.20184 of 2022 by the mother of the prosecutrix for the recovery of the prosecutrix allegedly from the forcible confinement of the main accused Akash.
On 22.09.2022 during the course of proceedings, the prosecutrix herself appeared before the Division Bench of this Court alongwith the main accused Akash who was respondent No.6 in the Habeas Corpus petition and informed the Court that she had gone with the main accused Akash on her own volition as she did not want to go with the respondent No.4 in the writ petition with whom her parents had forcibly got her married to.
The statement of the prosecutrix was recorded under 164 on 01.03.2023 in which she has given a totally different versions and has made allegation against the applicant herein.
However, giving due regard to the fact that the prosecutrix herself had appeared before the learned Division Bench of this Court alongwith the main accused Akash and wherein she has stated that she had gone with the main accused on her own volition as she was forcibly married of to the person whom she had referred to as her husband, cannot be ignored as the said statement was made before the two judges of this Court which was recorded in the order dated 22.09.2022.
Thus, on a prima facie appreciation of material on record, this Court comes to the conclusion that apparently the case is one of consent though the prosecutrix is a minor and the role of the applicant herein even if deemed to be true and correct, is peripheral and not associated with the main offence of the rape.
opennyai_summary.21_April_2023__arguments: Learned counsel for the applicant submits that there is a further twist in this case.
opennyai_summary.21_April_2023__decision:
Under the circumstances, the application is allowed.
It is directed that if the applicant Shubham herein is arrested by the Arresting Officer, he shall be enlarged on bail upon his furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand Only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the Arresting Officer.
C.C. as per rules.

opennyai_summary.final__decision:
The applicant is in jail since 27.06.2023.
Under these circumstances, counsel prays for grant of bail to the applicant.
Consequently without commenting on the merits of the case, first bail application under Section 439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure for grant of bail filed on behalf of applicant, stands allowed.
7. It is directed that applicant be released on bail on his furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty thousand only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court, for his regular appearance before the trial Court during trial with a condition that he shall remain present before the concerned Court on all the dates fixed by it during trial.
He shall abide by all the conditions enumerated under Section 437(3) of Cr.P.C.
8.
This order shall be effective till the end of the trial.
However, in case of bail jump and breach of any of the conditions of bail, it shall become ineffective.
